headline: Pose coverage: limited — Pose detected on 1720/2261 frames (76% coverage). Gaps reduce usable duration. Detected landmarks and visibility scores are not a claim of accurate tracking.
Contact coverage: insufficient — L 4% known · R 33% known · event cycles 2 L / 1 R. Unequal missing-data coverage is not a gait-laterality finding.

Spectral reliability: limited — Spectral reliability from duration 68.48 s, gap fraction 24%, ≈66.5 stride cycles in the series, ACF peak ρ=0.82. This is not pose coverage or video quality — ACF reliability is moderate (score 0.90).

Biomechanical validity: unavailable — Monocular COM–BoS is experimental: floor projection uses heuristic depth (Z), not a measured support polygon. The stable-frame percentage is a 2-D geometric proxy — not Hof margin of stability and not evidence from a pelvis-vertical COM graph. XCoM requires reliable horizontal COM velocity and pendulum length; those are not available from this video, so XCoM is diagnostic only.

clip.interval_counting_convention: Durations use original source timestamps, not 1/fps. A contiguous run of n valid frames contributes t[n-1] − t[0] (n−1 adjacent intervals). An isolated valid frame contributes 0 s. Analyzed span is last_analyzed_timestamp − first_analyzed_timestamp and includes internal gaps. Cumulative valid duration is the sum of those run lengths. Coverage = cumulative_valid_duration / analyzed_span. Longest valid segment is the maximum run length.

clearance_gate: NEAR_GROUND_THRESHOLD_M = 0.100 is a confirmed-flight / In-Air gate at estimated body-scale metres (canonical +Y, floor_y ground plane). It does not classify stance. Binary contact-off below this gate is Near Ground → Unknown, not swing and not stance. Do not lower the gate to manufacture swing, and do not equate low clearance with stance.
